papers.title: Hydra-0: Action Flow for Generalist World Modeling and Control
papers.summary: We introduce Hydra-0, a generalist world model conditioned on action flow, which represents robot actions as pixel motion. Achieves 90.4% lower robot-motion error and 60.2% lower object-motion error. Supports zero-shot composition and data-efficient adaptation.

papers.title: From Corpora to Co-Evolving Capabilities: Capability-Centric Data Design for Generalist Image Generation
papers.summary: A capability-driven data infrastructure that couples capability-specific supervision construction with capability-aligned curriculum scheduling. Curates 440M-image T2I corpus, trains 3B and 6B multimodal diffusion models.

papers.title: Multi-Agent AI System for Radiology Report Structuring and Quality Assurance
papers.summary: A multi-agent AI pipeline for radiology report structuring and QA. Structured 22,270 sentences, flagged 14.1% of reports. Radiologists rated performance as excellent/good in 84% of cases.

papers.title: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification
papers.summary: Re-evaluation of memory-based self-improving agents. Key finding: agent improvement is highly dependent on task order, and evaluation is inherently noisy. Detailed rubrics and environment feedback help but gaps remain.

papers.title: EDITBRIDGE: Towards Faithful and Efficient Ultra-High-Resolution Image Editing
papers.summary: A diffusion bridge framework for ultra high-resolution image editing. Achieves 3.6-8.4x speedup at 2K, enables 4K editing in 61 seconds. Uses prior-guided block-wise sparse attention.

papers.title: TokEval: A Tokenizer Evaluation Suite
papers.summary: A comprehensive tokenizer evaluation suite. Language model tokenizers are typically selected with minimal evaluation, despite their design choices directly impacting model capabilities.

papers.title: Deep Academic Survey: Stateful Agentic Closed-Loop Paradigm for Academic Survey Automation
papers.summary: DAS: a stateful agentic framework for generating publication-oriented academic surveys. Uses DAS-2M (2M paper metadata lake). Scores 4.34 on DAS-Bench (30 topics), beating strongest competitor at 4.03.

papers.title: GS-Voxel: Fitting-Free Structured Latents for Large-Scale 3DGS Generation
papers.summary: Converts unstructured 3D Gaussian reconstructions into sparse structured latents for scalable aerial scene generation via flow models. Key for large-area scene generation with overlap-aware tiled inference.

papers.title: aDSL: Agentic 3D Creation via Joint Agent-Program Design
papers.summary: Jointly designs an Agent-centric Domain-Specific Language (aDSL) and multi-agent system for 3D content creation. aDSL bridges semantic logic and geometric constraints, enabling agents to manipulate geometry through relational operators.

papers.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
papers.summary: Fine-tuning MoE models (Alibaba, OpenAI, NVIDIA) on low-resource language (Greek). SFT shifts reasoning into target language; RL with verifiable rewards fixes formatting defects. Accuracy benchmarks are noise at this scale.
